title: Act: Export ErrTimeout and wrap it in runAttempt
summary: Add ErrTimeout sentinel returned when an attempt exceeds Config.Timeout
description: Add a package-level ErrTimeout next to ErrBudgetExceeded and make runAttempt wrap it with the original deadline error when the attempt context expired while the parent context is still live.
acceptance_criteria: runAttempt returns an error satisfying errors.Is for both ErrTimeout and context.DeadlineExceeded when the attempt deadline fires
runAttempt does not add ErrTimeout when the parent ctx is already done
technical_constraints: Keep Go signature of runAttempt unchanged
definition_of_done: ErrTimeout declared with doc comment and applied in runAttempt

steps.action: Declare exported sentinel ErrTimeout directly after ErrBudgetExceeded with a doc comment saying it is returned (wrapped) when one agent attempt exceeds Config.Timeout.
steps.code:
// ErrTimeout is returned (wrapped) when an agent attempt exceeds Config.Timeout.
var ErrTimeout = errors.New("runner: agent attempt timed out")
steps.expected: runner package exports ErrTimeout and compiles

steps.action: Keep the WithTimeout call, store the agent result in cost and err, and when err != nil and tctx.Err() is context.DeadlineExceeded and ctx.Err() == nil, return cost and fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrTimeout, err); otherwise return cost, err unchanged.
steps.expected: Timed-out attempts wrap ErrTimeout and context.DeadlineExceeded
